## 1) Module autopilot (AUB) + select best
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best
```
What this should do:
- Execute the module experiments defined in `module_registry.yaml`
- Score candidates vs the current champion
- If a candidate beats the champion (by your framework’s criteria), it should update/mark the best one

After it finishes, check:
- Which candidate (if any) was promoted
- Any regressions in **min** (your min scores matter since champion’s tuning_min is relatively low: ~0.43)

## 2) System autopilot (end-to-end/system candidates)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run
```
What to look for:
- System-level improvements can be blocked by module-level weaknesses, so compare:
  - overall mean
  - worst-case/min
  - lockbox mean/min (you have lockbox_min ~1.13; protect that)

## 3) Generate next-fix report (actionable TODO list)
